title: Cam Operator-Decision Gate
description: Durable operator-decision gate marker written to .claude/.cam-gate.json (US-001, CAM-241/153). Persists an awaiting-operator pause across sidecar restarts: the sidecar writes gate/options/context when it needs an operator decision, the operator resolves it via `cam decide <decision>` which fills in `decision`, and the sidecar polls for a populated `decision` to resume deterministically.

gate.description: Discriminator naming which gate is active (e.g. 'in-progress-work-conflict'). Dispatched generically by consumers, never hard-coded to a single gate kind.

options.description: The valid decision strings the operator may choose between. `cam decide <decision>` validates its argument is a member of this array before writing `decision`.

context.description: Free-text context explaining why the gate is open, surfaced to the operator (e.g. by the orchestrator boot-read or a sidecar notify line).

decision.description: The operator's resolved choice, absent until `cam decide` writes it. Must be a member of `options` once populated.
